name: Tunnel wisp
description: A twisting gyroid cave with a mirrored waterline and a pulsing wisp of light running ahead of the camera. Mirroring the field about the horizon is what makes the reflection - there is no second pass.

speed.description: How fast the cave travels past.

twist.description: How hard the cave walls corkscrew with depth.

detail.description: Frequency of the second gyroid. The difference between the two scales is the cave surface, so this controls how crusted the walls look.

wisp.description: Brightness of the light running down the tunnel centre.

tint.description: Blend the wisp and walls toward the project palette.
